<details><summary>One optional change in <code>fuzz/fuzz_mux.c</code></summary>

1. The route check at `fuzz/fuzz_mux.c:297` only reads that the session's count `rx_frames + rx_ignored` grew (`session_rx_count()`, `fuzz/fuzz_mux.c:143-147`). The a0 check at `:306` only reads the frame when it is a data frame. `diginet_session_rx()` refuses a frame of length 0 as short, and adds 1 to `rx_ignored` (`transport/src/diginet_session.c:345-348`).

   So the change `transport/src/diginet_mux.c:179` `frame, len` -> `frame, 0` keeps every check of `fuzz_mux` true. But with it, the announce that made a desk appear no longer reaches the session that was attached in that notice (`include/diginet/transport/diginet_mux.h:20-22`). On the seed input `auto-attach`, the first e0 owes a `DIGINET_N_DESK` notice and an e2. With the change, neither comes for that e0.

   Line 148 has the same gap for each frame that is not data. The change `frame, len, now_us` -> `frame, f.h.cmd == DIGINET_CMD_DATA ? len : 0, now_us` also keeps every check true.

   To close the gap, check the frame that the session gets. For example: for each e0 or e1 of 33 body bytes or more, to the interface's MAC or to broadcast, that reaches an attached session, require one `DIGINET_MUX_N_SESSION` notice of kind `DIGINET_N_DESK` whose frame carries that announce's body. Add this record:

   ```
   mutant: transport/src/diginet_mux.c:179 `frame, len` -> `frame, 0`
   input: auto-attach
   ```

   Also add a breakage for line 148, with a seed input that routes an announce to an attached desk. When the change is in `Open-Mixer/libdiginet`, set `repo` to that commit in this pull request.

</details>
